title: Improve LLM-as-a-Judge Ability as a General Ability
authors_zh: Jiachen Yu, Shaoning Sun, Xiaohui Hu, Jiaxu Yan, Kaidong Yu, Xuelong Li
paper_type_zh: 生成式 LLM 裁判的训练、偏差过滤与偏好信号评测
best_for_zh: 构建开源 LLM 裁判，或用自动偏好信号训练策略模型的团队。
one_line: Two-stage SFT-DPO training turns filtered pairwise judgments into an open generative judge and tests its downstream preference signals.
以经双重核验的成对判决数据进行 SFT-DPO 训练，并审计其作为偏好信号的效用。
why: It exposes the data filters and evaluation boundary behind an open generative judge used as an RLAIF signal.
inclusion_reason: 公开的 judge 训练数据、权重与两阶段筛选流程可用于审计自动偏好信号的可靠性。

title: Problem
问题
html:
Generative LLM judges need costly preference data, can inherit position and length bias, and are usually assessed only as judges. That leaves uncertain whether a compact judge-training recipe preserves general chat ability or supplies useful reward signals for later policy training.

The paper builds a two-stage SFT-DPO recipe: GPT-4o produces candidate critiques under rewritten judge prompts, answer order is swapped and labels are checked against source preferences, then difficult cases become DPO pairs. It releases the resulting RISE-Judge weights and training data.

The intended object is a generative judge that explains and selects between two answers, not a scalar reward model. The paper evaluates both its judgment score and whether its outputs can annotate preference pairs for DPO.

生成式 LLM 裁判需要昂贵的偏好数据，容易继承位置和长度偏差，且通常只按“会不会裁判”评测。因此，紧凑的裁判训练配方能否保留通用对话能力、能否给后续策略训练提供有效奖励信号，并不清楚。

论文提出两阶段 SFT-DPO 配方：以改写后的裁判提示让 GPT-4o 生成批评，再用答案换位和源偏好标签核验；把困难案例转为 DPO 偏好对。作者公开了 RISE-Judge 权重及训练数据。

目标对象是能解释并在两个回答间选择的生成式裁判，而不是标量奖励模型；论文同时测量其裁判分数，以及其输出能否为 DPO 标注偏好对。

关键风险是自动偏好可能放大错误。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
RISE treats judging as a transferable capability: filtered, explanation-bearing pairwise judgments first teach a base model how to critique, then preference optimization targets the cases on which the teacher was unreliable. The official release includes RISE-Judge-SFT-20K and RISE-Judge-DPO-20K, two public datasets of judge instructions, answer pairs, analyses, and verdict-oriented targets for training generative judges.

This separates formatting and reasoning adaptation from selection accuracy, while keeping the training target inspectable as text rather than reducing it to an opaque score. The paper reports public model weights; the paper itself does not state a dataset license.

The data mainly draws on Math-PRM800K, several subsets of Skywork-Reward-Preference-80K, and limited proprietary general dialogue. The authors state that synthesized data do not overlap the evaluation benchmarks.

RISE 将裁判视为可迁移能力：先让带解释、经筛选的成对判决教会基座模型如何批评，再用教师不可靠的困难题做偏好优化。官方开放 RISE-Judge-SFT-20K 与 RISE-Judge-DPO-20K；两套数据包含裁判指令、回答对、分析和面向裁决的训练目标，用于训练生成式裁判。

它把格式与推理适配同选择准确性分开，并把训练目标保留为可检查的文本，而非不透明分数。论文报告了公开模型权重，但文中未写明数据集许可。

数据主要来自 Math-PRM800K、Skywork-Reward-Preference-80K 的多个子集和少量专有通用对话；作者声明合成数据与评测基准没有重叠。

其主要用途是裁判训练与偏好信号构造。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build varied judge prompts. GPT-4o rewrites a base pairwise-judge template by sampling roles, criteria, formats, and Chinese or English; the template, question, chosen answer, and rejected answer form the input.
  1. Generate and filter SFT judgments. GPT-4o writes a chain-of-thought critique and [[A]]/[[B]] verdict. The answer order is swapped; only judgments that select the source-dataset preferred answer in both orders enter SFT. Chosen and rejected answers are length-balanced.
  1. Warm up the base judge. Qwen2.5-32B-Base is trained with standard SFT on 20K filtered judge records plus limited proprietary non-judge dialogue data; the target is critique plus verdict.
  1. Construct difficult preference pairs. For prompts rejected by the teacher filter, the SFT model samples six judgments. Rule-based correctness filtering separates chosen and rejected judgments.
  1. Enhance with DPO. The SFT model is the DPO reference; DPO on 20K pairs is combined with an NLL term (alpha=0.2) to discourage over-optimization. Reproduction must fix the prompt sampler, source splits, GPT-4o version, random samples, and undisclosed proprietary dialogue data; its license is not stated in the paper.

SFT runs for two epochs with batch size 128 and maximum length 4,096; DPO runs for two epochs with batch size 32. Evaluation fixes temperature at 0 and top-p at 1. These budgets and random sources affect reproducibility.

1. 改写裁判提示。 GPT-4o 按角色、准则、格式及中英文重写成对裁判模板，并拼接问题和优劣回答。
  1. 生成并筛选 SFT 判决。 GPT-4o 输出分析和 [[A]] 或 [[B]]；交换回答位置后仍两次选中源数据偏好答案，记录才进入 SFT，并平衡回答长度。
  1. 预热裁判。 Qwen2.5-32B-Base 用 20K 筛选记录及少量专有非裁判对话做 SFT，学习“批评加裁决”。
  1. 构造难例偏好对。 对教师未稳定答对的提示，由 SFT 模型采样六个判决，再依正确性规则分出优劣结果。
  1. DPO 强化。 以 SFT 模型为参考，在 20K 对上训练 DPO 并加入 NLL 项（alpha=0.2）。复现须固定提示采样、源数据切分、GPT-4o 版本和随机样本；专有对话数据及许可未披露。

训练时 SFT 为两轮、批量 128、最大长度 4,096，DPO 为两轮、批量 32；评测温度固定为 0、top-p 为 1。上述预算和随机来源会改变可复现结果，不能省略。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim. The two stages, not merely a larger judge dataset, yield a strong open judge with 40K training records. Controlled setup. On RewardBench, the paper compares Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, SFT-only, DPO-only, and the same 32B base trained by SFT then DPO; evaluation uses greedy decoding (Table 1; Figure 3). Result. The final 32B model scores 92.7, versus 87.0 for Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, 87.7 for SFT-only, and 91.8 for DPO-only; it matches the 92.7 score of a 70B SFR judge trained on 680K records. Boundary. This supports the specified data and protocol on RewardBench, not a causal claim that every gain is due to filtering or that it transfers to all domains.

On an internal policy model, DPO data annotated by GPT-4o and RISE raise AlignBench average from 7.20 to 7.40 and 7.60, respectively. This supports signal utility but is not a public independently reproducible experiment. Other models in Table 1 use leaderboard scores, while the authors evaluate only the RISE and Qwen series; cross-model comparisons therefore also reflect release differences.

主张。 两阶段而非单纯扩大数据，可用 40K 记录训练强开源裁判。设置。 RewardBench 上比较 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct、仅 SFT、仅 DPO 与同一 32B 基座的 SFT 后 DPO，均用贪心解码（表 1、图 3）。结果。 最终模型为 92.7，高于 Instruct 的 87.0、仅 SFT 的 87.7 和仅 DPO 的 91.8，也与用 680K 记录训练的 70B SFR 裁判同为 92.7。边界。 这支持该数据和协议在 RewardBench 上有效，不能单独证明筛选贡献或所有领域迁移。

作者另在内部策略模型上比较 GPT-4o 与 RISE 标注的 DPO 对：AlignBench 平均分从基础模型的 7.20 分别升至 7.40 和 7.60。该设置支持信号可用，但不是公开、可独立复现实验。

表中其他模型的指标来自排行榜，作者仅自行评测 RISE 和 Qwen 系列；因此跨模型比较还受不同发布配置影响。

需谨慎解释。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier generative judges commonly use SFT to imitate verdicts or apply preference training without a judge-specific warm-up, often using 600K–900K records. RISE changes the training decision: it reserves teacher-inconsistent, hard prompts for self-sampled DPO pairs while using order-consistent GPT-4o critiques for SFT style adaptation. The contribution is this staged data contract and its tests of general ability and downstream policy training, rather than the invention of SFT, DPO, or pairwise judging.

Relative to simply imitating a teacher verdict, it retains critique text and makes the second phase compare the model's own correct and incorrect judgments. That makes error localization, formatting adaptation, and preference selection separately auditable, though it remains dependent on teacher and source-preference labels.

既有生成式裁判常以 SFT 模仿判决，或未经裁判专用预热直接做偏好训练，且常使用 600K–900K 条记录。RISE 改变的是训练数据的去向：教师不一致的困难提示留给自采样 DPO 对，双换位仍一致的 GPT-4o 批评用于 SFT 风格适配。新意是这一分阶段数据契约，以及对通用能力和下游策略训练的检验，不是发明 SFT、DPO 或成对裁判。

相对只复现教师结论的做法，它显式保留批评文本，并让第二阶段比较模型自己生成的正确与错误裁判。这使错误定位、格式适应和偏好选择成为可分别审计的对象。

代价是仍依赖教师与原始偏好标签。

该依赖决定可迁移边界。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The authors state that judgment precision is not consistent across domains, especially for open-ended and point-wise tasks. A deployment team should therefore validate agreement on its own task rather than treat RewardBench performance as a universal reward guarantee.

The filter defines correctness from source preferences and GPT-4o order consistency; a fluent but wrong critique can still become a target if those signals agree. Before reuse, audit retained rationales and test position, length, and reward-hacking failures on held-out responses. The downstream policy experiment is internal, so its gain cannot establish external RLAIF performance.

Limited proprietary general dialogue is mixed into training, but its size, contents, and license are not reported. External reproductions cannot exactly recreate the general-ability retention distribution and should document substitute data and resulting differences.

作者承认判决精度不能在所有领域保持一致，开放式和点式任务尤甚。部署团队应在自身任务上检验与人工的一致性，不能把 RewardBench 分数当成通用奖励保证。

筛选把源偏好与 GPT-4o 换位一致性视为正确；二者同意时，流畅但错误的批评仍可能进入目标。复用前应抽审保留推理，并在留出回答上测试位置、长度和奖励投机失败。下游策略实验为内部实验，不能证明外部 RLAIF 效果。

此外，训练混入少量专有通用对话数据，文中没有给出其规模、内容或许可；因此外部复现者无法精确复制“保留通用能力”的训练分布，应该报告替代数据和差异。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For an open generative judge, start with pairwise tasks that have trusted preference labels. Reuse the prompt diversification, answer swapping, teacher agreement filter, and SFT-to-DPO split to output an auditable judge dataset and then compare it with an instruction model on held-out preference benchmarks.

For RLAIF prototyping, use the released judge to rank multiple policy responses, construct best-versus-worst pairs, and measure the post-DPO policy with an independent evaluator. Do not directly adopt this recipe where answers are point-wise or highly open-ended, where source labels are weak, or where a proprietary-dialogue component cannot be replaced and documented.

Success checks should include target-domain human agreement, verdict flips after answer swapping, length correlation, and independent post-training scores. A high score from the judge itself does not establish that its reward signal is safe to reuse.

若要训练开源生成式裁判，应从有可信偏好标签的成对任务开始。可复用提示多样化、回答换位、教师一致性过滤和 SFT 到 DPO 的分流，产出可审计的裁判数据，再在留出偏好基准上与指令模型比较。

若做 RLAIF 原型，可用公开裁判对同一策略的多个回答排序，形成最好对最差的 DPO 对，并以独立评测器检查策略更新。点式或高度开放任务、弱源标签，以及无法替换并记录专有对话成分时，不应直接照搬。

成功检查应同时报告目标领域的人类一致性、换位后的裁决翻转率、长度相关性和策略更新后的独立分数；只观察到裁判自己的高分，不能说明奖励信号可安全复用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position. RISE is an open generative judge trained to separate critique-format learning from hard-case verdict optimization.
  • Mechanism. GPT-4o prompt rewriting, swap-consistency filtering, SFT, then self-sampled DPO are the key chain; the two-order check decides SFT admission.
  • Artifact. RISE-Judge-SFT-20K and RISE-Judge-DPO-20K provide public instruction, answer-pair, critique, and verdict targets; 32B and 7B weights are released.
  • Evidence. With a 32B Qwen base and 40K total records, RewardBench reaches 92.7 versus 87.0 for Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct; this is a benchmark-specific result.
  • Reuse decision. Best for pairwise, label-backed judge training; first audit retained critiques and bias on the target domain because open-ended and point-wise precision remains limited.

These decisions do not replace human sampling: admission verifies agreement with existing preference labels, not the factual correctness of every critique step. Establish an independent failure set before connecting the judge to policy optimization.

• 定位。 RISE 用两阶段训练把批评格式学习与困难案例的裁决优化拆开。
  • 方法抓手。 GPT-4o 改写提示、换位一致性筛选、SFT、自采样 DPO 依次进行；两次换位检查决定记录能否进入 SFT。
  • 数据抓手。 RISE-Judge-SFT-20K 和 RISE-Judge-DPO-20K 开放指令、回答对、批评与裁决目标，也开放 32B 和 7B 权重。
  • 证据锚点。 同一 32B Qwen 基座和 40K 记录下，RewardBench 从 87.0 升至 92.7；结论限于该基准。
  • 复用决定。 适合有标签的成对裁判训练；开放式和点式精度仍有限，复用前须审计目标领域的保留批评和偏差。

这些判断不能替代人工抽检：数据入选规则验证的是与既有偏好标签的一致，而非批评过程的每一步事实正确性；把它接入策略优化前应先建立独立的失效样本集。
